verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs say users can prompt AI agents from the dashboard to fix, update, and ship code, and can connect AI assistants to their account for deployment workflows. That is a first-party natural-language control path, but the evidence shows it covers code changes and deployment rather than operating the product broadly. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of wider product operations (DNS, domains, env vars, rollbacks, team access), detail on which commands are supported and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Prompt AI agents to fix, update, and ship code using your unique project context directly from your Netlify dashboard.
Share context & connect AI assistants to your Netlify account for seamless deployment workflows.
